title: Recover a suspended ad or platform account
summary: Losing an ad account cuts a growth channel overnight. The appeal that works is filed after the violation is fixed, not before. Read which policy they cited (Google Ads publishes its suspension reasons and appeal path; Meta's runs through the Business Help Center's account-quality flow). Audit what plausibly tripped it: billing mismatches, landing-page policy, circumventing-systems flags. Fix that first. Then file one complete appeal; five thin ones read as circumvention. While the appeal runs, move spend to channels you own, starting with your email list. Reinstatement is the platform's decision; nothing here promises it.

parts.title: Read the suspension notice: which policy is cited, and at what level (account, campaign, payment profile)

execution.rationale: Read the actual suspension notice and record its cited policy and affected account scope.

parts.title: Audit what could have tripped it: billing mismatches, destination/landing-page policy, circumventing-systems flags

execution.rationale: Compare supplied billing, destination and policy evidence to identify supported explanations for the suspension.

parts.title: Fix the underlying violation first — appeals filed with the violation still live get denied

execution.rationale: The advertiser and site owners correct the actual policy violation in the ad and destination systems and retain evidence of the changed state before appealing.

parts.title: File ONE complete appeal through the published flow with the fix documented (Meta's path runs through the Business Help Center's account-quality flow)

execution.rationale: The authorized account owner submits the reviewed appeal through the platform's published account-quality or support flow, preserving identity checks and avoiding duplicate submissions.

parts.title: Shift spend to the channels still standing while the appeal runs — the email list first; concentration was the real lesson

execution.rationale: The marketing owner reallocates approved spending in the available campaign systems and operates the customer email channel while reviewing the impact personally.

parts.title: Wait for the appeal decision — the clock is the platform's

execution.rationale: The advertiser checks the appeal channel and responds to platform requests digitally, recording the decision without assuming reinstatement.

metadata.trigger: Google Ads, Meta, or another ad/platform account is suspended: campaigns stop and a policy email names the violation.
metadata.supportReason: Policy enforcement and appeals run on the platforms' own judgment and consoles; an agent can audit the likely trigger and keep the owned channels running, but deciding what to fix and what to assert in the appeal is on the founder.

contextNeeded.query: the suspension notice (policy cited, account level)
